Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to complain about a flexible working discussion, which I attended at the community centre. Unfortunately, the service did not meet the expectations set out in the information provided before I booked.

I am writing to complain about [sự kiện / hoạt động], which I attended at [địa điểm]. Unfortunately, the service did not meet the expectations set out in the information provided before I booked.

paragraphs.text: The first problem was that there was almost no time for the advertised practical activity. In addition, the session started forty minutes late without an explanation. paragraphs.label: Mở thư và mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to complain about a community volunteer open day, which I attended at the community centre. Unfortunately, the service did not meet the expectations set out in the information provided before I booked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Dịch vụ, nơi và mục đích phàn nàn.

Ms Brown

parts.text:
,

I am writing to complain about
a community volunteer open day

parts.text: , which I attended at
the community centre
parts.labelVi: địa điểm

parts.text: . Unfortunately, the service did not meet the expectations set out in the information provided before I booked.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

I am writing to complain about [sự kiện / hoạt động], which I attended at [địa điểm]. Unfortunately, the service did not meet the expectations set out in the information provided before I booked.

paragraphs.label: Hai vấn đề
paragraphs.text: The first problem was that there was almost no time for the advertised practical activity. In addition, the session started forty minutes late without an explanation. I had expected a practical opportunity to explore local projects and choose manageable volunteer roles, so these problems were particularly disappointing.
